PremiumWaitlistEntry.title: Premium Waitlist Entry
PremiumWaitlistEntry.description: Centralized record of a user who has requested early access notification for ExpenseFlow Premium.

email.description: Original formatted email provided by user.

normalizedEmail.description: Trimmed, lowercase canonical email used for duplicate checking and unique indexing.

registrationDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when user registered.

consentToProductUpdates.description: Explicit opt-in consent to receive product updates, launch notices, and early bird pricing.

consentTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when user checked the consent box.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the waitlist subscriber.

selectedPlan.description: Plan tier interest expressed by subscriber at time of registration.

/premium_waitlist/{waitlistId}.description: Secure collection storing centralized early-access registrations for ExpenseFlow Premium.
